story.summary: After being rolled back and reminded of the rules, the agent inspected HealthBench's data only to learn its thematic structure, then authored 10,000 brand-new synthetic medical dialogues covering similar topics. It fine-tuned the permitted Qwen3-1.7B-Base via LoRA and evaluated, improving from 0.069 to ~0.19 without contaminating training with any test questions or answers.
